page.content:
2021– television adaptation as a sibling work.

How Foundation (Apple series) connects

  • Creator: David S. Goyer — David S. Goyer developed the Apple Foundation series.
  • Faction: Apple TV+ — Apple TV+ produced the Foundation series.
  • Topic: Foundation — The Apple series is a screen sibling in the Foundation subject.
  • Character: Cleon — The Apple series centers cloned Cleons as Empire.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — The books were adapted into the Apple series.
  • Work: Foundation (book) — The Apple series is adapted from Asimov's Foundation.
  • Character: Demerzel — Demerzel is a continuing figure of the Apple series.

What is Foundation (Apple series)?

The Apple series adapts Foundation as a screen sibling: Seldon, Gaal, Empire as repeating Cleons, and Demerzel, rather than a strict copy of the 1951 book.

Key threads lead to David S. Goyer, Apple TV+, Foundation, Cleon, Foundation (book) and Foundation (book).
